origine_fr: La force 力, la chair 月, et le bambou ⺮, la plante qui a le plus de fibres. C'est la force de la chair. Les fibres qui font la force du muscle : le tendon, 筋骨.
origine_en: Strength, 力, flesh, 月, and bamboo, ⺮, the plant with the most fibres. It is the strength of flesh. The fibres that give a muscle its strength: tendons, 筋骨.

phrase.zh: 游泳的时候，他的腿抽筋了。
phrase.pinyin: Yóuyǒng de shíhou, tā de tuǐ chōujīn le.
phrase.fr: En nageant, il a eu une crampe à la jambe.
phrase.en: While swimming, he got a cramp in his leg.
